data.description: Batch rename files based on custom naming rules
data.descriptionEn: Batch rename files based on custom naming rules
data.descriptionZh: 按自定义规则批量重命名，让文件命名规范统一
data.readme:
· Batch renames files by rules such as date, sequence number, or project name
· Prompts for confirmation when name conflicts or uncertainties occur
data.readmeEn:
· Batch renames files by rules such as date, sequence number, or project name
· Prompts for confirmation when name conflicts or uncertainties occur
data.readmeZh:
· 帮你按日期、序号、项目名等规则批量改名
· 遇到重名或不确定的情况会先提示你确认
